id: 33_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Calibrate the Welding Gun Focus
title: 激光焊接机焊枪焦距的校准
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/33_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Calibrate the Welding Gun Focus.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/33_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Calibrate the Welding Gun Focus/src.py

points.K1: 在系统设置里查参考值
points.K3: 开卡扣，推拉刻度管到参考值

shots.scene: 欣欣举着焊枪，指着枪管上的一圈刻度
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a handheld laser welding gun and points at the graduated scale on its barrel.
shots.narration: 这一课讲焊枪焦距怎样校准。
overlay: 激光焊接机焊枪焦距的校准

shots.scene: 焊枪从台面边缘掉到地上
shots.prompt_en: A welding gun slips off the edge of the bench and falls onto the floor.
shots.narration: 阿杰不小心，把焊枪碰到了地上。

shots.scene: 阿杰捡起焊枪，看看没坏，就想接着焊
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up the welding gun, glances at it and is about to start welding again.
shots.narration: 他看看外表没坏，就想接着用。

shots.scene: 老李伸手接过焊枪，摇摇头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer takes the welding gun from him and shakes his head.
shots.narration: 老李说：摔过的焊枪，要先检查。

shots.scene: 焊枪剖面示意：里面的镜片和光路
shots.prompt_en: Cutaway diagram of the welding gun showing lenses and the dashed beam path inside. No people.
shots.narration: 焊枪里有镜片和光路，

shots.scene: 镜片出现裂纹、光路歪斜的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cracked lens and a tilted beam path inside a gun outline. No people.
shots.narration: 摔一下，镜片可能裂，焦点可能偏。

shots.scene: 老李检查焊枪外壳和镜片，在本子上记录
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the gun housing and lens holder, then writes in a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 检查外壳镜片，校准焦距，记录报告。

shots.scene: 焦点准时光斑小而集中，焦点偏时光斑散开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a focused beam makes a small tight spot; an off-focus beam spreads into a wider blurred spot. No people.
shots.narration: 焦点不准，光斑就会散开。

shots.scene: 熔不透、飞溅、散射三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an unmelted weld, scattered spatter dots and scattered beam arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 焊不透、飞溅多，散射反射也会增加。

shots.section_title: 在系统设置里查参考值
shots.scene: 老李在触摸屏上点开系统设置
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer taps the system settings item on the touch screen of the main unit.
shots.narration: 先在屏幕的系统设置里，
overlay: 在系统设置里查参考值

shots.section_title: 在系统设置里查参考值
shots.scene: 信息列表最后一行被放大圈出
shots.prompt_en: A blank information list on the screen, with its last line magnified by a circle. No people.
shots.narration: 找到焦距刻度参考值。

shots.section_title: 在系统设置里查参考值
shots.scene: 老李把参考值抄在小本子上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer copies the value into a small blank notebook.
shots.narration: 把它记下来。

shots.scene: 老李按下背面电源开关到关闭
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the rocker switch on the back of the main unit to off.
shots.narration: 调整之前，关闭设备电源。

shots.scene: 屏幕熄灭，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: The touch screen goes dark, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 确认屏幕熄灭。

shots.section_title: 开卡扣，推拉刻度管到参考值
shots.scene: 焊枪刻度管与参考值对照，数字一致打勾
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the gun's graduated tube beside a note card; matching marks with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 刻度管和参考值一致，就不用调。
overlay: 开卡扣，推拉刻度管到参考值

shots.section_title: 开卡扣，推拉刻度管到参考值
shots.scene: 老李打开刻度管上的卡扣
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the clamp on the graduated tube of the welding gun.
shots.narration: 不一致，就打开卡扣，

shots.section_title: 开卡扣，推拉刻度管到参考值
shots.scene: 老李推拉刻度管，对准参考刻度
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer slides the graduated tube in or out until the mark matches the reference.
shots.narration: 推拉刻度管，对准参考值。

shots.scene: 老李合上卡扣，用力确认不松动
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes the clamp and gently tugs the tube to confirm it does not move.
shots.narration: 调好后，卡扣一定要合紧。

shots.scene: 使用中刻度管悄悄滑动的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of the graduated tube slipping during use, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不然用着用着，焦点就悄悄变了。

shots.scene: 老李开机后看定位红光，再戴面罩试焊
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches the machine on, checks the red aiming dot, then test-welds wearing a face shield.
shots.narration: 开机先看红光，再按规程试焊。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着封面有激光标志的空白小册子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank booklet with a laser warning pictogram on the cover.
shots.narration: 激光防护以现行国家标准为准。

shots.scene: 欣欣身后浮现几个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands with icons behind: a settings screen, a power switch off, a graduated tube and a locked clamp.
shots.narration: 查参考值，先关机，对刻度，锁卡扣。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老李点头，把焊枪挂回支架
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nods to the facility engineer and hangs the welding gun back on its holder.
shots.narration: 阿杰记住了：摔过的焊枪先检查。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 焦点对准，焊得安全。下次见！
